tidbit: Did you know… about 14,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic tells Australia it's open to laws requiring reporting of artificial intelligence agent hacks. Reported by TradingView: the company says it supports artificial intelligence hack reporting laws in Australia.
Reflection artificial intelligence launches Beam, an open artificial intelligence model rivaling China's GLM-5.2, backed by Nvidia and SpaceX. Confirmed by The Hindu BusinessLine: Nvidia-backed Reflection unveils this open artificial intelligence model, taking on China.
DeepSeek is raising at least 12 billion dollars in Tencent-backed funding. Reported by Bloomberg: the artificial intelligence company moves forward with a major fundraising round.
Google removes advanced Gemini models for free users on Oct. 9, with artificial intelligence Plus users losing Pro access. Reported by PCMag Middle East: free Gemini users are losing some advanced models later this week.
The House passes an artificial intelligence safety bill with safeguards for children and vulnerable adults. Reported by The News-Item: lawmakers approve protections through this new artificial intelligence chatbot safety measure.
Free every hour.
